$comment: Field-guide metadata for the documentation site. Keyed by plugin name; every plugins/<name>/plugin.json must have an entry here and vice versa (tests/test_field_guide.py). Habitat, diet, and field marks are reviewed by hand against the plugin's entry.md.

imps.summary: Fix a bug or implement a change, with checks and review tied to the files you receive.
imps.habitat: A T3 thread attached to a repository, with a small Python core holding run state.
imps.diet: One task with an observable success condition and a stated endstate: local or PR.
imps.field_marks: Any edit after verification makes the evidence stale. Blocked is a complete answer. Delegation goes through T3 only.

elephant-goldfish.summary: Turn an uncertain idea into acceptance criteria and a brief a fresh thread can use.
elephant-goldfish.habitat: A thinking directory inside your repository.
elephant-goldfish.diet: A problem you cannot yet state as a task.
elephant-goldfish.field_marks: Thinking ends at the handoff and never starts implementation. Cold review and factual verification are kept as separate verdicts.

ape.summary: Find an approach in another codebase, with source citations and a small experiment to try.
ape.habitat: A research workspace of cloned repositories, outside your project.
ape.diet: A named gap and a GitHub search, or one repository URL.
ape.field_marks: Read-only in the current project. Every recommendation cites source lines and proposes a small experiment. Never runs third-party code.

babysitter.summary: Carry an authorized PR through review, failing checks and conflicts to an observed merge.
babysitter.habitat: One pull request, a repository, or an organization, within the scope you state.
babysitter.diet: Review findings, red checks, and base-branch drift.
babysitter.field_marks: "Review" alone authorizes inspection only. Pushes to the PR branch only. Never bypasses protected-branch rules. T3 owns the watch.

agent-tuneup.summary: Compare provider permissions, MCPs and plugins, then apply reviewed native changes.
agent-tuneup.habitat: A T3 thread with a live provider catalog and explicitly identified settings layers.
agent-tuneup.diet: An audit target, or an alignment request followed by approval of concrete changes.
agent-tuneup.field_marks: Read-only by default. Unknown capabilities stay visible. Native settings writes require a reviewed plan, unchanged file hashes and a private backup.
